svg.title: Rightsizing: technical evidence before financial claims
svg.desc: Accept, reject, or defer a recommendation rather than treating it as an instruction. Read the numbered cards from top to bottom. Billing reservations are not capacity guarantees, and deallocation does not eliminate every cost.
svg.text: Rightsizing: technical evidence before financial claims
Accept, reject, or defer a recommendation rather than treating it as an instruction.
Include seasonal demand, application objectives, and commitment coverage.
Check memory, input/output, compatibility, availability, and missing evidence.
Classify family limits, size restrictions, placement, and allocation failures.
Run a safe canary or abort
Plan disruption, capture state, enforce stop criteria, and validate the application.
Compare equivalent usage periods and account for commitments and residual costs.
Keep assumptions, rejected alternatives, owners, and the next review visible.
Billing reservations are not capacity guarantees, and deallocation does not eliminate every cost.
